refresh_policy.rationale: Collection reuses the owner's signed-in claude.ai browser session and reads the web app's own JSON endpoints; it requests no data export and sends no email. Automatic refresh is session-reuse-only: first collection and expired sessions need the owner to sign in through the browser handoff. Each run reads at most 200 changed conversations.

reason_display_messages.anthropic_live_backlog_deferred: This run read as many changed Claude conversations as one run allows. The rest are read on later runs from the saved checkpoint.
reason_display_messages.no_chat_organization: No Claude organization with chat access could be found for this account.

pageshim.login_message: Sign in to Claude, then return here.

streams.name: conversations
streams.description: Claude.ai conversations, read live from the signed-in session.

display.label: Your Claude conversations
display.detail: Conversation titles, create/update times, project membership, starred flag and the conversation's current model. The message count is filled in only when messages are collected in the same run. One organization per account; temporary chats and conversations deleted on claude.ai are not included or retracted.

title.description: Encoded as pdpp-safe-escape-v1: each code unit in U+0000-0008, U+000B, U+000C, U+000E-001F, U+007F-009F or a lone surrogate (U+D800-DFFF not part of a valid pair) is written as a six-character \uXXXX escape with uppercase hex. A source backslash that starts a \uXXXX whose code unit is in that set or is U+005C is written \u005C. All other text, including noncharacters and valid surrogate pairs, is unchanged. To decode, replace each \uXXXX whose code unit is U+005C or in the escaped set with that code unit. Conversation title. Never truncated: when the escaped text is over 10000000 characters the field is absent from the record and the run reports an exceeds_inline_cap count.

blob_ref.description: The raw source envelope as a Core blob. Absent when the envelope is over the host blob cap (33554432 bytes); the typed record and its children are still complete.

streams.name: messages
streams.description: Messages within Claude conversations, all branches. Claude records the model on the conversation, not on a message: model is the conversation's model when the message was collected, on assistant messages only.

display.label: Your Claude messages
display.detail: Role, text content, parent message, create/update times and attachments for every message, including edited branches. Thinking and tool-call blocks are not included in the text. The model is the conversation's model at collection time (model_source says so), so it can be wrong for messages written before the model was switched.

content.description: Encoded as pdpp-safe-escape-v1: each code unit in U+0000-0008, U+000B, U+000C, U+000E-001F, U+007F-009F or a lone surrogate (U+D800-DFFF not part of a valid pair) is written as a six-character \uXXXX escape with uppercase hex. A source backslash that starts a \uXXXX whose code unit is in that set or is U+005C is written \u005C. All other text, including noncharacters and valid surrogate pairs, is unchanged. To decode, replace each \uXXXX whose code unit is U+005C or in the escaped set with that code unit. Full message text. When the escaped text is over 10000000 characters it is not truncated: content is null and blob_ref holds the full text. When the text cannot be stored (the host has no blob store, or its JSON encoding exceeds 33554432 bytes) content and blob_ref are both absent from the record; the run reports an aggregate count.

blob_ref.description: Present only when content is null because the message text is over the inline cap. The blob (application/json) is the JSON string of the exact source text, with no pdpp-safe-escape-v1 escaping: JSON.parse(bytes) returns the source text for the content field.

attachments.description: Attachment objects as exported. Every string key and string value inside is encoded as pdpp-safe-escape-v1 (see messages.content for the encoding).

streams.name: account_plan
streams.description: The subscription plan of the signed-in Claude account's chat organization, with its renewal and end dates. Same fields as the ChatGPT account_plan stream.

display.label: Your Claude plan
display.detail: Which plan the organization is on (free, Pro, Max, Team…), its rate-limit tier, whether the subscription is active, its billing period and renewal date, and when the organization was created. will_renew is inferred for an active subscription only (a next charge and no end date) and is empty otherwise. cancels_at and scheduled_plan_change are always empty: Claude exposes no source for them. Usage limits are in usage_limits. Payment details and billing identifiers are not collected. Singleton — one record for the organization the session reads.

streams.name: usage_limits
streams.description: Claude usage limits for the signed-in account's chat organization: the share of each limit used and when it resets.

display.label: Your Claude usage limits
display.detail: One record per limit Claude reports (the current session, the week, and any per-model weekly limit): percent used, reset time, severity and whether it is currently the binding limit. Claude reports percentages, not absolute caps. Extra-usage spend and credit balances are not collected.
